aboutGame.title: What is Apocalypse Rising 2?
paragraphs: Apocalypse Rising 2 is an open-world zombie survival shooter on Roblox from developer Dualpoint Interactive. Players spawn on a tropical archipelago with nothing and then scavenge weapons, armor, backpacks, and medical supplies while fighting infected and hostile survivors.

Progression is loadout-based rather than level-based: the gear you loot from civilian towns, military bases, helicopter crashes, and boss drops decides how strong you are. With grid inventory management, PvP firefights, drivable cars and boats, and a sprawling island map, every run is a fresh fight to stay alive.

modules.name: Apocalypse Rising 2 Beginner Guide
modules.description: First-spawn survival basics covering safe loot priorities, inventory limits, combat fundamentals, and how to stay alive against infected and hostile squads.

highlights.detail: Spawn on a coastal island and grab a melee weapon, backpack, food, and water before moving inland.
Loot quiet rural houses, garages, and farm sheds instead of contested military zones.
Manage the grid inventory: carry one primary, one secondary, and enough medical supplies.
Crouch-sprint through foliage and avoid open highways that expose you to snipers.
Learn infected behavior and always secure the perimeter before looting a body.
Track hunger, thirst, bleeding, and temperature so survival damage never catches you off guard.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Apocalypse Rising 2.

items.question: What is Apocalypse Rising 2?
items.answer: Apocalypse Rising 2 is an open-world zombie survival shooter on Roblox developed by Dualpoint Interactive. You spawn on a tropical archipelago, loot weapons and supplies, fight infected and hostile players, and try to survive with everything you carry.

items.question: Is Apocalypse Rising 2 free to play?
items.answer: Yes. Apocalypse Rising 2 is free to play on Roblox, and you only need a Roblox account to join a server.

items.question: Does Apocalypse Rising 2 have codes?
items.answer: Apocalypse Rising 2 does not currently use a redeemable code system. Free rewards come from events, badges, and seasonal updates, so ignore any site promising free cosmetic codes.

items.question: What are the best weapons in Apocalypse Rising 2?
items.answer: 7.62x51mm NATO battle rifles such as the FAL, G3, and M14 dominate thanks to fast time-to-kill, while the M16A1 and AKM are more forgiving mid-tier primaries.

items.question: How do you progress in Apocalypse Rising 2?
items.answer: There is no account level tree; progression in Apocalypse Rising 2 is loadout-based. You get stronger by looting military zones, helicopter crashes, and boss drops for better guns, armor, and backpacks.

items.question: What platforms is Apocalypse Rising 2 on?
items.answer: Apocalypse Rising 2 is played through Roblox on PC, mobile, and console, so servers and progress are shared across devices.
